**Wire verb `sdrf pool`**: Merge several SDRF documents into one analysis table, stamping each row with the document it came from.

# Wraps

- [`SdrfCollection.Merge`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfCollection.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfCollection.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`SdrfDocument.WriteResults`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfDocument.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfDocument.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`

# Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `documents` (wire `--stdin`) | `string[]` | required | — | `>= 1 line` | One document per line: path, optionally a TAB and a provenance label. Label every line or none; a partial set is a usage error. Blank lines are ignored. |
| `out` (wire `--out`) | `path` | absent | — | — | Write the WHOLE merged document here as SDRF, whatever offset and limit are. The write is atomic since mzLib 1.0.592 (\#1324): a temp file moved into place. |
| `offset` (wire `--offset`) | `int` | `0` | rows | `>= 0` | Skip this many merged rows in the payload. |
| `limit` (wire `--limit`) | `int` | absent | rows | `>= 0` | Return at most this many merged rows. Absent means every row. |

# Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `document_count` | `int` | documents | never | Documents pooled. |
| `paths` | `string[]` | — | never | The paths, in stdin order. |
| `labels` | `string[]` | — | never | The label stamped for each document: the one supplied, or mzLib's containing-folder/file-stem default. |
| `columns` (wire `column_names`) | `string[]` | — | never | The union header in SDRF block order; a repeated name at the highest multiplicity any one document used; comment\[source document\] added. |
| `row_count` | `int` | rows | never | Merged rows before the window. |
| `returned_count` | `int` | rows | never | Rows in rows. |
| `offset` | `int` | rows | never | The offset applied. |
| `truncated` | `bool` | — | never | True whenever rows were left out. |
| `rows` | `string[][]` | — | never | Row-major raw cells, as for sdrf read. |
| `written` | `object` | — | yes: out was not given | {path, row\_count}; row\_count is the whole merged document. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Four static caveats, plus a fifth when no labels were supplied. |

# Errors

| Kind | mzLibRust returns | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`MzLibError::Usage`](crate::MzLibError::Usage) | stdin empty; a blank path; a file not found; some lines labelled and some not |
| `usage` | [`MzLibError::Usage`](crate::MzLibError::Usage) | offset or limit negative or not an integer |
| `correctness` | [`MzLibError::Bridge`](crate::MzLibError::Bridge) | mzLib cannot read one of the documents |
| `service_unavailable` | [`MzLibError::ServiceUnavailable`](crate::MzLibError::ServiceUnavailable) | never returned by this verb |

Any call can also fail on the way to mzLib or back, whatever the verb: [`MzLibError::BridgeNotFound`](crate::MzLibError::BridgeNotFound), [`MzLibError::Timeout`](crate::MzLibError::Timeout), [`MzLibError::Protocol`](crate::MzLibError::Protocol) or [`MzLibError::Io`](crate::MzLibError::Io).

# Caveats

- An ANALYSIS table, not a deposit: source name + assay name + comment\[label\] is unique per document, not across documents. Key on comment\[source document\] too.
- Without labels, provenance depends on where the files sit, so the table is not reproducible on another machine.
